name: Caltech Fall 2015

venue.name: [California Institute of Technology](http://www.caltech.edu/)
venue.details: Annenberg Center, room 105. See website for more details.

information: The cost of registration is $10 if you are doing four or fewer events, and $20 if you are doing five or more events. If you do not pre-register online by Nov 14th, the fee will be doubled. There is a 100-person competitor limit. If you are a Caltech student, just show your student ID and the registration fee will be waived. $1 per competitor goes to the WCA.
